annotation.title_clean: К вопросу о формализации этики поведения коллаборативного робота
annotation.title_en: On the issue of formalization of collaborative robot ethical behavior
annotation.venue: Информационные и математические технологии в науке и управлении
annotation.summary_en: Journal article page (abstract only) on mechanisms enabling a collaborative robot to be a moral agent. Argues classical and non-classical logics cannot formalize ethics; proposes utilitarianism with hedonistic axiology, analysed via cognitive maps, and three principles of robot moral behaviour based on needs, perception and self/other identification.
key_provisions_or_claims: Logic-based formalization of ethics fails under inherent contradictions and incompleteness.
Moral schemes should primarily provide an explanatory component for behaviour.
Utilitarianism (Bentham, Mill) combined with hedonism proposed as the basis for robot ethics.
Robot behaviour is determined by current needs and the state of its perception system.
Morality rests on comparing conspecifics with 'self' (own/alien degree).
